purpose: Compare natural, manually rewritten, and automatically rewritten queries using the same hybrid retrieval index.

metrics.target_mrr: For each case, average reciprocal rank across its predefined target chunks; a missing target contributes zero.
metrics.target_coverage_at_20: Number of predefined target chunks found in the top 20, divided by the number of predefined target chunks.
metrics.aggregation: Report both per-case metrics and macro averages across cases.
